{{Quote|I remember your commander. Blak, yes?|A patron of Krakin's Alehouse|<ref name="Remember When">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20051006rememberwhen|text=Remember When|int=Remember When}}</ref>}}
'''Blak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked for the [[organization]] of the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After Blak was caught selling a cargo to the [[Blood Velkers]], Nirama had him strung up and used as a dummy, for members of his organization to practice their [[Vibroblade/Legends|blade]] drill on. A male [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who had served under Blak later mentioned his [[Commander/Legends|commander's]] fate while having a conversation in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Krakin's Alehouse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Behind the scenes==
Blak was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and received a brief mention in ''[[Remember When]]'', article that was added to [[Wizards.com]] in [[2005]] as part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign.
